label: prepare-static-source-upload
command: import pathlib,json,subprocess; r=pathlib.Path("."); paths=set(subprocess.check_output(["git","diff","--name-only"],text=True).splitlines()); paths.update(subprocess.check_output(["git","ls-files","--others","--exclude-standard"],text=True).splitlines()); paths={p for p in paths if p.startswith(("tools/","research/static-wayne/","logs/","config/",".github/")) or p in ("README.md","artifacts/delivery-status.json")}; entries=[{"path":p,"mode":"100644","type":"blob","content":(r/p).read_text()} for p in sorted(paths)]; pathlib.Path("/tmp/static-upload.json").write_text(json.dumps(entries,ensure_ascii=False)); print(len(entries),pathlib.Path("/tmp/static-upload.json").stat().st_size); print("\n".join(sorted(paths)))
action: 准备上传静态实现、容量来源、离线报告和本轮操作证据。
outcome: 源码上传清单已生成，排除了大镜像和派生 inode 数据。
next_step: 提交到仓库后启动静态 Actions 工作流。
